verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents creating Payment Links via its API ('Create a Payment Link'), and its hosted MCP server explicitly lets an AI agent 'create and manage payment links', so the payment-link step can be done in an agent session. The evidence shows no product or price catalog objects that an agent could provision first, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: API or MCP creation of product and price objects, an end-to-end documented flow chaining product → price → link in one session, and hands-on corroboration.
